match: India vs West Indies Today Match

c01_fixture_research.match: India vs West Indies, 5th T20I (Series Decider)
c01_fixture_research.research_notes: Iconic high-scoring venue with true bounce and rapid outfield. Evening games feature heavy dew.

verification_alerts: Bhuvneshwar Kumar (IND) confirmed in playing XI as strike pace option (150kph+).
Tilak Varma (IND) confirmed at #4 with part-time off-spin role against WI left-handers.
Jewel Andrew (WI) taking lower-order wicketkeeping slot at #7.

tactical_implications: IND bowling first will benefit from maximum grip and swing in 1st innings Powerplay.
Dew in 2nd innings (dew factor: 0.32) will reduce spin grip by ~20%, heavily favoring IND top-order batters.
WI death bowlers will face wet ball conditions, increasing boundary conceded rate by 18%.
c03_toss_analysis.recommended_strategy: Anchor heavy lineup around IND top-order chase masters and IND death pacers.

c04_pitch_intelligence.surface_profile: Flat batting wicket with true bounce and thin air (~920m altitude). Extremely high six-hitting venue. Short square boundaries (58-62m). Early movement for hit-the-deck pace, but true paradise under lights. Chasing sides won 7 of 10 IPL matches.

in_play_degradation.tactical_guidance: Dew severely impairs finger spin grip; favor pacers with cutters and top-order chasing batters.

c04_pitch_intelligence.key_fantasy_takeaway: Pacers account for 64.0% of dismissals at M.Chinnaswamy Stadium, Bengaluru. Death pacers with hard yorkers and express bounce have highest wicket ceiling.

impact_on_fantasy.bowler_risk: Fingerspinners defending total will suffer higher economy rate; pacers relying on cross-seam grip slightly hindered
impact_on_fantasy.batter_boost: 2nd innings batters gain +12% boundary conversion due to wet outfield skid

key_danger_zones.tactical_note: Bhuvneshwar Kumar has dismissed Shai Hope 2 times in 22 balls at SR 109.1.
Axar Patel has dismissed Rovman Powell 2 times in 28 balls at SR 103.5.

key_batter_advantages.tactical_note: Sanju Samson dominates Shamar Joseph striking at 200.0.

tactical_style_insights: India's Top 5 contains 3 Left-Handers (Abhishek, Ishan, Tilak): Roston Chase (offbreak) will be utilized in powerplay & middle overs.
Shivam Dube strikes at 209+ against left-arm orthodox spinners (Akeal Hosein / Motie). Dube is a major matchup counter-pick.
Kuldeep Yadav's chinaman/googly historically troubles West Indies middle-order power hitters (Powell, Rutherford strike <95 against Kuldeep with high dismissal rates).

Powerplay (Overs 1-6).tactical_focal_point: New ball swing vs aggressive boundary clearing

Middle Overs (Overs 7-15).tactical_focal_point: Spin squeeze vs boundary rotation and matchup exploitation

Death Overs (Overs 16-20).tactical_focal_point: Yorkers, slower cutters vs all-out maximum clearing. Highest fantasy point yield per over.
